correctness.rationale: Peter-Weyl/Schur reduces norm to sup_{m>=1}|U_m(cos theta)|/(m+1). The m=1 lower bound t and m=2 lower bound |4t^2-1|/3 give >=1/4 globally with equality possible only t=1/4. At equality m=3 gives 7/32 and for m>=4 the strict bound <=4/(5 sqrt(15))<1/4 is uniform over infinite tail. Independent numerical first 1000 highest weights at both angles confirmed only m=1,2 saturate and max m>=3 equals 7/32. Selfadjointness gives power identity. Full analytic proof does not rely on numerical enumeration.

value.rationale: Sharp optimization of an actual natural compact-group one-step mixing kernel, including all irreducible equality classes and all-step exact rate, is potentially reusable. It is a motivated exact optimization despite elementary Chebyshev bounds and no general compact-group theorem.

final_claim: For one fixed SU(2) conjugacy-class step, the minimal norm on mean-zero Haar L2 is 1/4, only at cos theta=+/-1/4; exactly m=1 and m=2 characters saturate, and optimal k-step contraction is 4^(-k).
